back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -3. After this test resolves, if there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location, that enemy attacks you.
[cultist]: -2. If there is a [[Syndicate]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: -3 (-5 instead if you are at an [[Otherworld]] location).
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, choose an [[Ally]] or [[Witness]] asset. Something abducts that asset.
name: Traces to Nowhere
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -2. If you fail and there is a [[Monster]] enemy at your location, that enemy attacks you.
[cultist]: -1. If there is a [[Syndicate]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at an [[Otherworld]] location).
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, deal 1 horror to a [[Witness]] asset in play.

back_flavor:
You've seen some pretty unbelievable things in your day. Things that, if you tried to explain them to any sane person, would all be dismissed as a bunch of malarkey.
But you know the truth, the stone-cold facts that would rain down on the fragile little lies the rest of the world chooses to believe. Your hopes for this to be a simple missing-persons case are dashed when you see the first sign of the supernatural. A shadow that moves on its own, a low growl rolling out of a dark alley, the way the light doesn't seem to reach as far as it should.
You get the feeling the city isn't going to give up its secrets that easily.
back_text: Shuffle each enemy and treachery in the set-aside Dimensional Madness encounter set (other than the double-sided Abductor enemy) into the encounter deck.
flavor: Many describe Arkham as 'sleepy,' but you know better. Where others see a city grown lethargic in mundanity, you instead see a den of hardened criminals and unsolved mysteries. One woman thought she could make a difference, and the city swallowed her whole. Now it's up to you to pick up the pieces.
name: Hard Case
text: Forced - When a story asset would be defeated: Something abducts that asset, instead.

back_flavor: You expected the hitmen, the hired guns, and the false leads. All of that was part of the job, after all. But you didn't expect the portals from another world, nor the influence of an alien realm creeping into Arkham. Whatever is responsible for abducting these people, you seem to have drawn its attention.
back_text:
Something abducts the top card of each investigator's deck.
Search the encounter deck and discard pile for the 3 copies of The Mystery Deepens and the 3 copies of the Back to Square One treacheries. Remove these cards from the game.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Shuffle the top 1 [per_investigator] cards of the encounter deck into the leads deck.
flavor: You can't shake the feeling that someone - or something - is following you.
name: From Another Dimension
text: Forced - After doom is placed on this agenda: The investigator with the most clues must reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] is revealed, spawn the set-aside Abductor enemy engaged with that investigator. If it is already in play, it attacks that investigator instead. Forced - When a story asset would be defeated: Something abducts that asset instead.

back_flavor: The rain hammers down on you as you stand face-to-face with the abductor itself - monster, man, or something else. You're out of ammo and out of options. You know that everyone's on borrowed time in this crazy, uncaring world. And it seems your time is finally up.
flavor: The night drags on, like a cigarette burning down to the filter. You need to crack this case before it cracks you.
name: Running Out of Time
text: Forced - After doom is placed on this agenda: The investigator with the most clues must reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] is revealed, spawn the set-aside Abductor enemy engaged with that investigator. If it is already in play, it attacks that investigator instead. Forced - When a story asset would be defeated: Something abducts that asset instead.

back_flavor: No sooner do you leave the meeting with the witness than the air around you crackles with lightning - violet lightning. You barely have enough time to curse your luck when an audible CRACK! echoes down the rain-slick streets. You hear an alarmed scream and the breaking of glass, and you realize it's all coming from the direction of your next destination.
back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Abductor enemy at the same location as the [[Witness]] story asset farthest from each investigator (or, if Abductor is already in play, move it to that location). If no [[Witness]] story asset is in play, reveal cards from the top of the leads deck until a [[Witness]] story asset is revealed. Resolve that asset's revelation effect and spawn the set-aside Abductor enemy into play at that asset's location (or, if Abductor is already in play, move it directly to that location). Shuffle each other card revealed this way into the leads deck.
Shuffle the set-aside Crooked Cops enemy into the leads deck.
flavor: Aziza Steer was one of the best private detectives the city had to offer. But with her gone, it now falls to you. Will you close the case? Or will you be the next victim?
name: Taking Over the Search
text: Forced - When the round ends, if there are no [[Witness]] assets in play and no cards in the leads deck: Each surviving investigator is defeated. Objective - After the first chaos token is sealed on the scenario reference card, immediately advance. (Hint: You'll have to follow up on your leads to make progress in your investigation!)

back_flavor: The night stretches on, but at least you're finally starting to make progress.
back_text: Check which tokens are sealed on the scenario reference card. If there are... - ...a [skull] token and a [cultist] token, shuffle the set-aside Lina Husserl and Vicar Yang story assets into the leads deck. - ...a [tablet] token and a [cultist] token, shuffle the set-aside Albrecht Husserl and Matilde Correa story assets into the leads deck. - ...a [skull] token and a [tablet] token, shuffle the set-aside Elias Husserl, Jr. story asset into the leads deck. If "the investigators found something strange in the funeral home basement," swap Duterte Funeral Home (After Hours) with the set-aside Duterte Funeral Home (Something in the Basement), keeping all tokens and attachments.
flavor: This isn't just a bunch of goons harassing the city. Arkham's become the hunting grounds for something else, something that can appear anywhere it wants, seemingly at any time. You wonder whether it's too late to turn down the case and head home.
name: More Than You Bargained For
text: Forced - When the round ends, if there are no [[Witness]] assets in play and no cards in the leads deck: Each surviving investigator is defeated. Objective - After the second chaos token is sealed on the scenario reference card, immediately advance.

back_flavor:
The city is full of winding streets of lost futures and broken promises. When you're not running into dead-ends, you're getting stuck in the same ruts that stopped the police force, Miss Steer, and anybody else who tried to look into this - or any other - missing persons case. The darkness of the night bears down on you like the mob goons who were hired to stall your progress.
This investigation is spiraling out of your control, so much that now you're looking for clues in the strangest of places. But nothing is off limits to a desperate detective, and the case of the Husserl family has made you awfully desperate.
The night is cold, but pulling your coat tighter about your shoulders helps to ward it off. Turn around and get back out in the city. You've got an abductor to catch.
back_text: Why are you here? Each investigator takes 1 horror. Flip this card over.
flavor: You're closer than you've ever been. All of your leads, all of the witnesses, have pointed you to the same person. Now all you've got to do is find what they've done with the missing people, turn them over to the police, and close this case once and for all.
name: The Culprit
text: Objective - You must explore the city of Arkham and hunt down leads to discover how to advance this act!

back_flavor: You eventually make your way to Steer's Office to find a strange sight. Glass shards litter the floor, and amidst it all you see a strange object: milky white, semi-translucent, with long, thin tendrils splayed wide. You can't make out if it is a plant or an animal, but whatever it is, it appears inanimate.
name: Steer's Office
text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card of the leads deck. [action]: You take time to study Aziza's notes. Choose a revealed [[Arkham]] location with no investigators. Place 1 [per_investigator] clues (from the token pool) on that location, up to its clue value.

back_flavor: The Merchant District runs along the southern banks of the Miskatonic River on the western side of town. Rows of old houses, converted to businesses in decades past, are busy during the day, but quiet and empty after nightfall.
name: Merchant District
text: [fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

back_flavor: One of the oldest districts of the city, French Hill is home to estates and manors dating back to the Colonial era.
name: French Hill
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each investigator at French Hill must test [willpower] (X), where X is 1 more than the number of clues on French Hill. Each investigator who fails must discard 1 card at random from their hand.

back_flavor: All Saints Roman Catholic Church of South Arkham, colloquially known as South Church, plays host to a dwindling congregation and a wearied clergy.
name: South Church
text: [action][action]: You spend some time in the quiet sanctuary. Heal 2 horror and draw 2 cards. (Group limit once per round.)

back_flavor: Boasting a library packed with books and documents cataloguing Arkham's history, as well as museum displays of archaeological finds and historical objects, the Arkham Historical Society holds many secrets otherwise lost to time.
name: Historical Society
text: [action]: You hear disturbing stories of Arkham's past. Draw the topmost treachery in the encounter discard pile. That treachery gains surge. Then, discover 2 clues from this location. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Albrecht Husserl
text: Revelation - Put the set-aside Tick-Tock Club location into play. Put Albrecht Husserl into play at Tick-Tock Club. [action]: Parley. ([codex] E).

name: Elias Husserl Jr.
text: Revelation - If Train Station is set aside, put it into play. Put Elias Husserl Jr. into play at Train Station. [action]: Parley. ([codex] I).

name: Eugene Peel
text: Revelation - If Train Station is set aside, put it into play. Put Eugene Peel into play at Train Station. [reaction] After a [[Syndicate]] enemy is defeated at Eugene Peel's location: Parley. ([codex] J).

name: Lina Husserl
text: Revelation - Put Lina Husserl into play at Merchant District. [action]: Parley. ([codex] H).

name: Matilde Correa
text: Revelation - Put the set-aside Arkham Advertiser location into play. Put Matilde Correa into play at Arkham Advertiser. [action] If there are no clues on Matilde Correa's location, and "the investigators found record of Matilde's bribe": Parley. ([codex] F).

name: Vicar Yang
subname: Trying to Do the Right Thing
text: Revelation - Put Vicar Yang into play at South Church. [action]: Parley. ([codex] G).

name: Albrecht Husserl
text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Dimensional Shambler is at Albrecht Husserl's location: He takes 1 damage. [action] If Albrecht Husserl has 1 or more damage on him: Parley. Flip him and resolve his text.

name: Luck Running Out
flavor: With nowhere to run, you confront Albrecht Husserl. His injuries have given him pause, opening the door for you to convince him to return to Arkham once and for all.
text:
Choose an investigator at Albrecht Husserl's location to test [agility] (4). Before revealing chaos tokens, investigators at Albrecht Husserl's location may spend 1-4 clues, as a group. For each clue spent this way, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1.
- If that investigator succeeds, flip this card over and move Albrecht Husserl to The Portal (or to any [[Arkham]] location, if he is at The Portal).
- If that investigator fails, flip this card over and Albrecht Husserl attacks that investigator, disengages from all investigators, and moves directly to the Dimensional Shambler's location.

name: Eugene Peel
text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Dimensional Shambler is at Eugene Peel's location: He takes 1 damage. [action] If Eugene Peel is exhausted: Parley. Flip him over and resolve his text.

name: You're Coming with Me!
flavor: With nowhere to run, you corner Mr. Peel. You pick him up off the ground, ready to bring him back to Arkham - by force if you need to.
text:
Choose an investigator at Eugene Peel's location to test [combat] (4). Before revealing chaos tokens, investigators at Eugene Peel's location may spend 1-4 clues, as a group. For each clue spent this way, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1.
- If that investigator succeeds, flip this card over and move Eugene Peel to The Portal (or to any [[Arkham]] location, if he is at The Portal).
- If that investigator fails, flip this card over and Eugene Peel attacks that investigator, disengages from all investigators, and moves directly to the Dimensional Shambler's location.

name: Lina Husserl
text: Aloof. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Dimensional Shambler is at Lina Husserl's location: She takes 1 damage. [action] If you are engaged with Lina Husserl: Parley. Flip her over and resolve her text.

name: Snap Out of It!
flavor: You grab ahold of Lina and force her to look at you. Her eyes connect with yours, and it is clear she is struggling with seeing the world of her nightmares stretched out before her. You need to convince her to return to Arkham while you deal with this monster.
text:
Choose an investigator at Lina Husserl's location to test [willpower] (4). Before revealing chaos tokens, investigators at Lina Husserl's location may spend 1-4 clues, as a group. For each clue spent this way, reduce the difficulty of this test by 1.
- If that investigator succeeds, flip this card over and move Lina Husserl to The Portal (or to any [[Arkham]] location, if she is at The Portal).
- If that investigator fails, flip this card over and Lina Husserl attacks that investigator, disengages from all investigators, and moves directly to the Dimensional Shambler's location.

name: Crooked Cops
text: Revelation - Put Crooked Cops into play at a connecting location. Forced - After an investigator parleys: Crooked Cops moves directly to that investigator's location. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. Automatically evade Crooked Cops.

back_flavor: The spectral winds of an alien world assault you as you stand face-to-face with the abductor itself. You're out of ammo and out of options. You know that everyone's on borrowed time in this crazy, uncaring world. And it seems your time is finally up.
flavor: Just when you thought you had seen it all, you are thrown like a ragdoll into a pit of ashen sludge and broken bones, beneath an indigo sky of unfamiliar stars.
name: Into the Pit
text: Forced - After doom is placed on this agenda: Choose one abducted card beneath Dimensional Shambler's location, at random, and attach it facedown to Dimensional Shambler. (It is no longer considered abducted.) Forced - After a [[Syndicate]] enemy spawns at an [[Otherworld]] location: Flip that enemy facedown and attach it to Dimensional Shambler, if able.

back_flavor: Lina blinks, looking around the darkened streets of Arkham as if just waking up from a dream. Her eyes fall to you, and the realization of all the mayhem she had caused - whether inadvertently or by design - settles in. She falls to her knees, overcome with a mixture of grief, guilt, and relief. The nightmare that has been hanging over her mind for so long is finally over.
flavor: Lina Husserl's dreams are no ordinary fancies in the dead of night. Her nightmares hold some kind of power, and her paintings have brought them to life.
name: Lina's Nightmare
text: Forced - After Lina Husserl is defeated: (→R4) Objective - When the round ends, if Dimensional Shambler is in the victory display and Lina Husserl is at an [[Arkham]] location, advance. (Hint: Anyone still abducted will be left behind!)

back_flavor: Eugene Peel stumbles through the portal and back onto the streets of Arkham. He stands on shaking legs, and attempts to run, but you grab him before he can get far. You're not about to let this goon get away after chasing him across worlds. He struggles at first, but soon recognizes his schemes have come to an end, and it's time for him to face the music.
flavor: While Junior planned to flee the city, Mr. Peel had plans of his own. Now you need to stop him before he can bring his cult's plans to fruition.
name: Mr. Peel's Scheme
text: Forced - After Eugene Peel is defeated: (→R4) Objective - When the round ends, if Dimensional Shambler is in the victory display and Eugene Peel is at an [[Arkham]] location, advance. (Hint: Anyone still abducted will be left behind!)

back_flavor: Albrecht Husserl stumbles through the portal and back onto the streets of Arkham. He stands on shaking legs, and attempts to run, but you grab him before he can get far. You're not about to let this goon get away after chasing him across worlds. He struggles at first, but soon recognizes his schemes have come to an end, and it's time for him to face the music.
flavor: Albrecht owes a lot of money to a lot of powerful people. His desperate attempts to hold on to power in his family have gotten out of hand.
name: Albrecht's Gamble
text: Forced - After Albrecht Husserl is defeated: (→R4) Objective - When the round ends, if Dimensional Shambler is in the victory display and Albrecht Husserl is at an [[Arkham]] location, advance. (Hint: Anyone still abducted will be left behind!)

name: Arkham Advertiser
text:
[action] Take 1 direct horror: You browse tomorrow's headlines. Discover 2 clues from this location. (Group limit once per game.)
[action]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. After resolving that card's revelation effect, flip this card over and resolve its text.

name: Yesterday's News
flavor:
You sneak into the offices, careful to avoid the few late-night workers. The Husserl family puff pieces that the Advertiser has been running recently were all written by the same reporter: Matilde Correa. After some searching, you locate her desk. You don't find much, but you do notice that one desk drawer has a false bottom, which lifts away to reveal a yellow envelope stuffed with documents.
Extracting the envelope, you find it contains a wad of cash, and all sorts of photos of Albrecht Husserl - leaving the Tick-Tock Club, handing a briefcase over to Arkham police officers, collecting strange glass jars from robed figures in French Hill.
One photo shows the floor of Aziza Steer's office. Glass fragments are scattered about, and in the center of the photo is a strange, flower-like jellyfish creature.
text:
Remember "the investigators found record of Matilde's bribe." (Group limit once per game).
Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped again for the remainder of the scenario.

back_flavor: Tickets tend to cost more than they should, but even still it seems there are more passengers departing than arriving.
name: Train Station
text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate this location, instead of discovering clues: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Syndicate]] enemy and spawn it at Train Station.
[fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

name: Tick-Tock Club
text:
[action]: You sit down at a table to win some cash. Flip this card over and resolve its text.
[fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

name: Gambling Your Time Away
flavor: The Tick-Tock Club is alive with activity, as wealthy patrons take their chances gambling away more money than you've seen in your entire career. You've got the investigation to worry about, but you wonder if you could find the time to play a hand or two and maybe walk away with some stuffed pockets.
text:
Each investigator at Tick-Tock Club may spend 2 resources to play blackjack. Then, one at a time, each investigator who did so reveals random tokens from the chaos bag until they choose to stop. Treat each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] as a 5; the [auto_fail] as a 10; and the [elder_sign] as either a 1 or an 11. If the combined value of the revealed tokens (ignoring +/-) is...
- ...18 or less, gain 3 resources.
- ...19, gain 4 resources.
- ...20, gain 5 resources.
- ...21, gain 8 resources.
- ...22 or more, you bust and gain nothing.
Flip this card back to its location side.

name: Duterte Funeral Home
text:
[action]: If there are no clues on Duterte Funeral Home, flip it over and resolve its text.
[fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

name: A Glimpse Beyond
flavor:
You descend into the basement of the funeral home. The thick, sweet smell of ozone hits your nose before you set foot on the bottom step. You follow the smell to a broom closet at the end of the hall. Opening the door, you see shelves and tools tipped over, the closet reduced to a mess. But from beneath everything, you see a faint lavender light, almost washed out by the light of the hallway behind you.
You kneel down and clear some of the objects, revealing the concrete floor of the closet. The floor is covered in a spiderweb of cracks, and you spend some time looking at the light seeping up through those lines. As you run your fingers along the cracks you can feel the hairs on your arm stand up.
Something is happening here, but you don't know what to make of it quite yet. Perhaps if you come back and check on it later?
text:
Remember "the investigators found something strange in the funeral home basement." (Group limit once per game.)
Flip this card back over. It cannot be flipped again for the remainder of the scenario.

name: Duterte Funeral Home
text:
[action]: If there are no clues on Duterte Funeral Home, flip it over and resolve its text.
[fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

name: Pulled Below
flavor:
You return to find the glowing light even brighter. Working to clear the pieces of floor away, you note how the shards of concrete peel away like wet canvas. With each piece you remove, the lavender glow intensifies, until you are staring down at a swirling, purple cloud just below the floor of the broom closet.
A wind coming from nowhere in particular pulls at you, blowing against your back and pushing you forward. Downward. Into that spiraling mass of light. The only thing you have time to do is hold your breath as you disappear beneath the funeral home.
text:
If the Ethereal Perch location is set aside, put it into play. Move each investigator at this location to Ethereal Perch.
Shuffle any remaining set-aside copies of Lost to the Darkness into the encounter deck.
Flip this card back over. It cannot be flipped again for the remainder of the scenario.

name: Meiger Estate
text:
[action]: If there are no clues on Meiger Estate, flip it over and resolve its text.
[fast] During your turn (except during a skill test), spend 4 resources: You hire a cab. Choose an [[Arkham]] location with no enemies. Move to that location. You may spend 1 action to reduce this ability's cost by 2.

name: Unlocking the Truth
flavor:
The storied mansion in Arkham's French Hill district plays host to all sorts of parties these days. It isn't hard for you to get inside, and after mingling briefly you learn that Lina Husserl was a frequent attendee, though most of the guests express relief that she has been absent lately. Your questions about her behavior are met with stories of her obsessing over a locked door on the top floor of the manor.
You make up an excuse to leave the conversation, and visit the door yourself. It stands like a slab of cold, black stone, with a symbol etched into its surface: three arrows, fanning apart as they point up towards the ceiling. You reach out to grasp the door's handle, and are shocked to find it unlocked.
text: Flip this card over and swap it with the set-aside Meiger Estate (Beyond the Black Door), keeping all tokens and attachments.

name: Meiger Estate
text:
[action] Spend 2 clues or take 1 horror: Flip this card and resolve its text.
[action]: You pass through the Black Door. Move directly to Ethereal Perch. You may only activate this ability if "the investigators glimpsed another world."

name: Across the Threshold
flavor:
You're unable to ignore your own curiosity. You turn the knob, the click of the door's mechanism echoing in your mind like a gunshot. There is no sound as the door swings open. Beyond you see a shifting, purple field, like a thin sheet that's been draped across the doorway. On the other side of this ethereal boundary, you see a rolling black field with strange trees.
A wind from nowhere blows against your back, pushing you forward. The only thing you have time to do is hold your breath as you disappear within and the door slams behind you.
text:
If the Ethereal Perch location is set aside, put it into play. Move each investigator at this location to Ethereal Perch.
Shuffle any remaining set-aside copies of Lost to the Darkness into the encounter deck.
Remember that "the investigators glimpsed another world."
Flip this card over. It cannot be flipped again for the remainder of the scenario.

name: Josephine Husserl
text: Revelation - Put Josephine Husserl into play at Historical Society. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4). You may spend 1 clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 3. If you succeed, ([codex] A).

name: Adele Husserl
text: Revelation - Put Adele Husserl into play at the [[Arkham]] location farthest from each investigator. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). You may spend 1 clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 3. If you succeed, ([codex] B).

name: Gladys Washington
text: Revelation - Put the set-aside Duterte Funeral Home (After Hours) into play. Put Gladys Washington into play at Duterte Funeral Home. [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (4). You may spend 1 clue to reduce the difficulty of this test by 3. If you succeed, ([codex] C).

name: Charles Tamm
text: Revelation - Put Charles Tamm into play at Steer's Office. Investigators at Charles Tamm's location cannot spend clues. [action]: Parley. ([codex] D).

name: Bruiser
text:
Hunter.
Damage dealt by Bruiser must be assigned to [[Ally]] assets, if able.

name: Hired Enforcer
text: Retaliate. [action] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Discard Hired Enforcer.

name: The Cleaner
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with clues). Spawn - Any [[Arkham]] location with 1 or more clues (and no investigators, if able). Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if The Cleaner is ready: Flip 1 clue on The Cleaner's location to its doom side and place it on him.

name: The Mystery Deepens
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). For each point you fail by, move 1 clue from your location to a revealed [[Crime Scene]] location with no investigators. If you failed and no clues were moved by this effect, take 2 horror.

name: Back to Square One
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each clue you control (to a maximum of +3 difficulty). If you fail, lose 3 resources.

name: Heavy Rain
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location with 1 or more clues and no copy of Heavy Rain attached. Otherwise, Heavy Rain gains surge. Attached location gets +1 shroud. No more than 1 clue at a time may be discovered from attached location. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Heavy Rain.

name: Drawing Heat
text: Revelation - Put Drawing Heat into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you leave a location with one or more unengaged non-[[Elite]] enemies: Ready those enemies and move them to your location. [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, discard Drawing Heat.

name: Approaching Shadow
text: Revelation - Put Approaching Shadow into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - When a non-aloof enemy is drawn from the encounter deck: That enemy spawns engaged with you and makes an immediate attack. Then, discard this card. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard this card.

name: Over Your Shoulder
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide: Either something abducts an [[Ally]] asset at your location, or you take 1 direct horror.

name: Disappearing Evidence
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either discard 1 card at random from your hand, or an [[Ally]] asset at your location takes 1 horror.

name: Locked Out
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either lose 1 action, or an [[Ally]] asset at your location takes 1 damage.

name: Aziza Steer
text: Forced - After Aziza Steer is rescued: Put her into play under the control of an investigator at an [[Otherworld]] location. [reaction] After 1 or more damage and/or horror from an enemy attack is assigned to Aziza Steer, exhaust her: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror.

back_flavor: The portal sizzles and crackles in the air, a tear in the fabric of reality connecting this hellish plane of existence to the sleepy streets of Arkham.
name: The Portal
text:
[action] Take 1 direct horror or 1 direct damage: Move to any revealed [[Arkham]] location.
[action]: Rescue 1 card beneath this location, at random. You may spend 2 clues to rescue an additional card beneath this location, at random.

back_flavor: Jellyfish-like flowering bulbs sprout from the boughs of a semi-translucent tree, its tentacular roots writhing and gripping about the edge of the cliff face.
name: Ethereal Perch
text: Forced - After this location is revealed, if any [[Otherworld]] locations are set-aside: Put them into play. Forced - When the round ends: Place clues (from the token pool) on this location, up to its clue value.

back_flavor: The collection of bones of various shapes and sizes rattle and clack as they shift in the gray sludge of the pit. The presence of human bones makes you realize you aren't the first person to witness this disturbing memorial. But with any luck, you could be the last.
name: Bone Pit
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each investigator at Bone Pit must either take 1 damage or 1 horror. [action] Investigators at Bone Pit spend 1-3 clues, as a group: You try to save those in the pit. For each clue spent, choose 1 card at random from beneath this location and place it beneath The Portal.

name: Abductor
text: Alert. Retaliate. Each investigator at Abductor's location cannot parley. Forced - When you successfully fight or evade Abductor: Set it aside, out of play. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, or after Abductor attacks you: Something abducts an [[Ally]] or [[Witness]] asset at this enemy's location. Set Abductor aside, out of play.

name: Dimensional Shambler
text: Retaliate. Patrol (location with the most facedown cards beneath it). Dimensional Shambler gets +1 fight for each card attached to it (to a maximum of +4 fight). Forced - When you deal 1 or more damage to Dimensional Shambler: Remove 1 facedown card attached to it from the game. Then, heal 2 damage from Dimensional Shambler.

name: Ambushing Shadow
text: Forced - After Ambushing Shadow attacks you: You must either lose 1 clue or discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Those Which Grasp
text: Hunter. Forced - After Those Which Grasp attack you: Choose an asset you control. Something abducts the chosen asset.

name: Aethereal Blight
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either discard an asset you control, or remove the top 2 cards of your deck from the game (shuffle each weakness removed by this effect back into your deck).

name: Lost to the Darkness
text: Revelation - Test [combat] (X), where X is the number of abducted cards. If you fail, take 2 damage.

name: Hungry Void
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide: Either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance).

name: Aziza Steer
text:
Reward.
[reaction] After you play an event during your turn, exhaust Aziza Steer. If that event was ...
- ...an [[Insight]] event: Discover 1 clue at your location.
- ...a [[Tactic]] event: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
- ...a [[Trick]] event: Gain 2 resources.
